title: Jaime Roos / Otra Vez Rocanrol
overview: Recorded live in November 2009 in Montevideo and Buenos Aires.  This DVD captures the essence of a night when Jaime Roos, along with his band Contraseña, invited several of the most prominent names in Uruguayan rock to perform a concert that fused their styles over a repertoire based on Roos's songs.  As a bonus, it includes a brilliant performance by Roos at Luna Park in Buenos Aires, just a week later, on November 14, 2009.
